name: kcc_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for Kisan Call Centre authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: kcc_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT raise grievances. Fails if OTP expired.

name: kcc_raise_grievance
description: Raises a new grievance ticket. Supports multi-domain grievances (pmkisan, pmfby, pmkusum, weather, market, soil, other). Generates unique ticket_id. Transitions grievance_status to 'raised'. Requires session_token. Does NOT resolve grievances. Fails if description is empty, category invalid, or duplicate grievance exists for same issue.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: kcc_get_grievance_status
description: Returns current grievance_status ('raised', 'assigned', 'in_progress', 'resolved', 'closed', 'escalated') with details. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify status. Fails if ticket_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

ticket_id.description: Unique identifier of the grievance ticket.

name: kcc_assign_grievance
description: Assigns a grievance to an appropriate expert/department based on category. Transitions grievance_status to 'assigned'. Requires session_token. Grievance must be in 'raised' status. Does NOT resolve grievances. Fails if already assigned or category routing is ambiguous.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: kcc_provide_response
description: Records a response or update for a grievance from the assigned expert. Transitions response_status to 'provided'. Requires session_token. Grievance must be 'assigned' or 'in_progress'. Does NOT close the grievance. Fails if grievance is not assigned or already closed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: kcc_escalate_grievance
description: Escalates an unresolved grievance to higher authorities. Transitions grievance_status to 'escalated'. Requires session_token. Grievance must be in 'in_progress' or 'assigned' status with no satisfactory resolution. Does NOT resolve the issue. Fails if grievance is already resolved/closed or not yet assigned.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: kcc_close_grievance
description: Closes a resolved grievance. Grievance can ONLY be closed after resolution or user confirmation. Transitions grievance_status to 'closed'. Requires session_token. Does NOT reopen grievances. Fails if grievance is not in 'resolved' status or closed prematurely.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

closure_confirmation.description: Farmer's confirmation to close. Must be true.

name: kcc_submit_feedback
description: Submits farmer feedback after grievance resolution. Transitions feedback_status to 'given'. Requires session_token. Grievance must be in 'resolved' or 'closed' status. Does NOT reopen the grievance. Fails if grievance is not resolved/closed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: kcc_get_grievance_history
description: Retrieves all past grievances for the farmer. Requires session_token. Does NOT raise new ones. Fails if no history exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: kcc_update_grievance_details
description: Updates the description or details of an existing grievance. Only possible when status is 'raised' or 'assigned'. Requires session_token. Does NOT change category or priority. Fails if grievance is beyond 'assigned' status.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: kcc_resolve_grievance
description: Marks a grievance as resolved after investigation. Transitions grievance_status to 'resolved'. Requires session_token. Grievance must be 'in_progress'. Does NOT close it — farmer must confirm via kcc_close_grievance. Fails if not in 'in_progress' status.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: kcc_set_priority
description: Sets or updates the priority level of a grievance. Allowed levels: 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'. Requires session_token. Does NOT resolve the grievance. Fails if ticket_id invalid or grievance already closed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: kcc_track_response_status
description: Tracks whether a response has been provided for a grievance. Returns response_status ('not_provided', 'provided', 'acknowledged'). Requires session_token. Does NOT provide responses. Fails if ticket_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: kcc_resolve_category_ambiguity
description: Resolves ambiguous grievance categorization when the issue spans multiple domains. Returns recommended category based on description analysis. Requires session_token. Does NOT re-categorize automatically. Fails if description is too vague.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
